book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: قال السندباد: ورثت مصاري من أبوي.
sentences.en: Sindbad said: I inherited money from my father.

sentences.ar: صرفتها كلها بسرعة على أصحاب وأكل.
sentences.en: I spent it all quickly on friends and food.

sentences.ar: لما خلصت، عرفت إني لازم أشتغل.
sentences.en: When it ran out, I knew I had to work.

sentences.ar: بعت اللي ضل عندي واشتريت بضاعة.
sentences.en: I sold what was left and bought goods.

sentences.ar: ركبت سفينة رايحة على بلاد بعيدة.
sentences.en: I boarded a ship going to far countries.
The sea was calm at first.

sentences.ar: كنت مبسوط وحاسس إني عملت صح.
sentences.en: I was happy and felt I had done the right thing.
